newsitem.title: USA: Incyte says in pact with Glaxo.
newsitem.headline: Incyte says in pact with Glaxo.

text.p: Incyte Pharmaceuticals Inc said Tuesday it signed a multi-year database partnership agreement with Glaxo Wellcome Plc.
The company said under the agreement, Glaxo Wellcome will pay annual fees for access to specific products in Incyte's LifeSeq gene sequence and expression database.
Incyte said it could also receive future royalties on sales of products developed with its technology and database information.
Details of the specific products licensed and financial terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
